changelog: Edited [When to Segment]: added permissive guidance to allow boundaries at quote openings, after short topical/subject NPs when the fragment is neutrally descriptive, and after subordinate clauses that do not assert reversible eventualities — to increase safe placement options.

Edited [Priority Rules]: added an explicit demotion for cuts that end immediately before a clause's main predicate or nominal head (rank them low unless the head already appears earlier in the piece) and raised guidance that openings of quoted clauses may be medium-confidence when the quoted content is self-contained — to reduce premature/high-ranked breaks before clause heads.
